how: We read the website of every New York City wedding videographer listed on Lazo (350 listings, 285 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Colorado chain with a New York landing page, a Super 8 filmmaker now based in France, DJ companies that add video, and elopement-package sites. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is ceremony and toast audio captured on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera? Loud city venues make this matter.
How long until the highlight film and the full edit arrive, and are the raw files included?
Will you shoot in a dim Brooklyn loft or a mirrored ballroom without a light stand in every photo? Ask how they light a reception.

picks.name: Susan Shek Photography
picks.blurb: Susan Shek Photography + Cinema has filmed and photographed New York City weddings since 2005, so stills and film come from one studio with one style. The process is laid out step by step on the site, with no scripts and no awkward posing.

picks.name: Danila Mednekov
picks.blurb: Danila and Lana are a Brooklyn-based photo and video team making intentional, design-driven wedding stories with full creative direction on every project. The packages page says most couples spend around $13,000 for full-day photo and video.

picks.name: Bilski Productions
picks.blurb: Bilski Productions is a boutique cinematography company out of St. James that films weddings from New York City to the North Fork, the Hamptons and Montauk. Films are tailored to each couple, so the studio does not offer formal packages.

picks.name: NuView Weddings Videography
picks.blurb: NuView Weddings Videography in Hauppauge makes cinematic and documentary wedding films across Long Island and NYC with a team formally trained in production and sound, shooting in 4K. A full-length documentary film is among the offerings.

picks.name: New York Wedding Video by Belinda Video Productions
picks.blurb: Belinda Video Productions launched in 2007 and creates wedding films for couples across Long Island, the Hamptons, the North Fork and New York City. The studio describes care, artistry and quiet attention to the moments that often go unnoticed.

picks.name: RF Studios | Luxury Wedding Photography & Cinematography
picks.blurb: RF Studios covers Nassau, Suffolk, NYC and destinations with a single coordinated photography and film team, so the two crews are not strangers on the day. Start with film, photography or both, and the collection is built around your timeline.

picks.name: Foxlight Studios
picks.blurb: Foxlight Studios is a Huntington boutique wedding studio producing both photography and cinema for Long Island and New York couples, with wedding albums as well. Packages are customized to each wedding rather than sold off a menu.

picks.name: Studio 27 Photography
picks.blurb: Studio 27 in Massapequa offers photography and cinematography and lets couples choose their photographer. The approach is documentary and collaborative; one couple notes their shooter arrived with their shot list printed out.

picks.name: Origin Photos
picks.blurb: Origin Photos is Filippo Barbarotto's photography and videography studio in Deer Park, serving Nassau and Suffolk. The team has been published in The Knot and A Touch of Modern, and pricing is shared once availability is confirmed.

picks.name: Visual Event Films
picks.blurb: Visual Event Films in Tarrytown, run by Jesse, offers a Full Story Package for couples who want the most from their wedding video, covering Westchester, Long Island and NYC. The process starts with a complimentary consultation.

picks.name: Live Picture Studios
picks.blurb: Founded in 2011, Live Picture Studios in Jersey City does New Jersey wedding videography and photography under one roof. The site is unusually open about the company culture it says attracts its team.

picks.name: Brian Delia Photography
picks.blurb: Brian Delia Photography pairs its lead photographers with cinematic videographers across Northern, Central and Southern New Jersey and NYC. The Verona studio has worked since 2009 and publishes its photography pricing, so ask for the combined collection.
